title: Limit Hom equation from coherent object triangles
statement: Given the coherent comparison objects of lem-pc-affine-model-coherent-object-comparisons, the limit conjugated Hom equation of def-pc-affine-model-comparison-data holds for every chain map on the two scalar-extended models. This is only the limit-arrow portion of the argument; the other arrows and the construction of the object comparisons are not conclusions. The maps are scalarExtensionHom [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] and perfectStageMap/perfectLimitMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport].

source.place: The explicit formula of def-pc-affine-model-comparison-data and the canonical termwise tilde definition; definitional constructor step.

proof.text:
Fix the arrow from j to the cocone point.
Apply naturality of the supplied full two-label comparison θ to the given chain
map a; it need not descend to the bottom. Scalar reassociation identifies
scalarExtensionHom with κE.hom followed by extension of a followed by κK.inv,
where κ is affineModelScalarAssocIso. The two object triangles express the
comparison at the target as κ, θ, pullback of the source comparison and the
inverse perfectHomComparison. Substitute these formulas and expand map_comp.
Cancel adjacent inverse pairs, use naturality of θ, then cancel its inverse
pair. The result is exactly the conjugated Hom transport written below.
Proof irrelevance identifies the generated pullback-instance proofs with the
named arrow representation. The argument includes identity arrows, zero rings,
zero complexes and coincident labelled objects.

proof_origin.place: Definitional introduction of the explicitly stated affine comparison-data formula; source representations are given by real named functor definitions.

lean.statement: theorem affineModelLimitHomEquation_of_coherent_objects {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (C : Cocone F) (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ) (d : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i), schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (F.obj j.val)) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))) (dlim : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (C.pt)) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))) (m : AffineModelCoherentObjects R c i Y s P Q F C E K d dlim) : ∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (a : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ))).obj E ⟶ ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ))).obj K), m.βE.inv ≫ (affineModelLocalizedTilde C.pt _ dlim).map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (C.ι.app j.val).hom (C.ι.app ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (C.w (homOfLE j.property)).symm) E K a) ≫ m.βK.hom = perfectLimitMap R c s j.val.property ((m.αE j).inv ≫ (affineModelLocalizedTilde (F.obj j.val) _ (d j)).map a ≫ (m.αK j).hom)
